newsitem.title: USA: US Gulf gasoline diffs rebound, heat oil near flat.
newsitem.headline: US Gulf gasoline diffs rebound, heat oil near flat.

text.p: U.S. spot gasoline prices eased at midday Friday, though Gulf Coast differentials jumped higher on solid demand.
Heating oil prices remained near steady Friday, with little movement seen in NYMEX prices or diffs, traders said.
Market watchers attributed the NYMEX gasoline weakness to news that Tosco had restarted its 140,000 barrels per day (bpd) catalytic cracker at its Bayway refinery.
However, gasoline diffs at the US Gulf may have been helped by news that Exxon took its 88,000 bpd catalytic cracker in Baytown, Texas into maintenance earlier this week.
USG conventional M4 gasoline for the front 4th cycle on the Colonial pipeline was talked between 1.00 and 1.25 cents under the screen, up at least 0.50 cent from early Friday levels.
Diffs for the thinly-traded M4 upline 3rd-cycle barrels firmed nearly 1 cent to sit at 1.75 cents under the screen, traders said.

New York Harbor prompt No. 2 oil barrels were bid at 0.25 cents under the print, traders said, though activity there remained subdued. Prompt low-sulphur barrels were offered at 0.15 cent under, showing a slight dip from Thursday's levels.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
